modeling_role: Defines what each row and column in the network matrix represents
review_requirement: Document whether nodes are facilities regions agents documents states sectors or components
responsible_use_warning: Centrality and vulnerability metrics are not meaningful if node types are unclear or mixed without justification

modeling_role: Defines what a relationship means in the network
review_requirement: Document whether edges represent flow dependency similarity communication probability cost or influence
responsible_use_warning: A connection does not automatically imply causality authority capacity or reliability

modeling_role: Defines how edge magnitudes should be interpreted
review_requirement: State whether larger weights mean stronger cheaper riskier more likely more costly or more capacious relationships
responsible_use_warning: Weight meaning must be clear before ranking optimizing or comparing network structure

modeling_role: Defines whether links are symmetric or directional
review_requirement: Document whether adjacency matrices are symmetric and whether in-degree and out-degree require separate interpretation
responsible_use_warning: Undirected simplification can hide asymmetric dependency or influence

modeling_role: Defines which nodes edges and external dependencies are included or excluded
review_requirement: Maintain a boundary register with omitted nodes omitted edges and external support assumptions
responsible_use_warning: Network vulnerability may be underestimated when external dependencies are excluded

modeling_role: Connects centrality metrics to specific definitions of importance
review_requirement: Report which centrality metric was used and why it matches the modeling purpose
responsible_use_warning: Centrality means importance only under the chosen representation and metric

modeling_role: Compares matrix outputs under node edge weight or boundary perturbations
review_requirement: Document stress scenarios removed elements and scenario assumptions
responsible_use_warning: Stress tests are scenario analyses not predictions unless validated against real failure behavior

modeling_role: Defines how network graphics should be interpreted
review_requirement: State whether layout is geographic algorithmic schematic or metric-based
responsible_use_warning: Graph layout can visually imply structure not supported by the model
